symptom: After `mxcli fix property-sets` completed every missing key on an 11.15 project (ChipCoV6 copy), Mendix's merge engine still saw a property-name mismatch: 4 `Microflows$CloseFormAction` elements carried `NumberOfPages`, which `mx convert -p` strips (ako/mxcli#1097 follow-up)
cause: An older mxcli wrote the int NumberOfPages (removed from the metamodel in 8.11; the current writer no longer does, #1373). The strip pass only dropped keys introduced AFTER the project's version, never keys removed BEFORE it, so stored units kept the stale name
insight: Do NOT drive removal from the generated metamodel's Deleted versions: they are wrong for keys Studio Pro still writes (LayoutGridRow.Columns 'deleted 8.0', JavaAction.Parameters 'deleted 7.21'), and trusting them made `fix property-sets --dry-run` want to strip ~297,000 keys from the Studio Pro-authored pedapp fixture. The control that caught it — dry-run over Studio Pro-authored projects must report 0 units — is the one to run before adding any row to the property tables. Removals are measured rows only, like the floors table
